caption: The drawing depicts a tall, cylindrical lidded tankard with a pronounced base and a domed lid topped with a decorative finial. The tankard has a large, ornate handle with an S-shaped curve, attached at the top near the lid and at the side near the base. The main body of the tankard is shaded in dark gray, gradually lightening toward the center, giving the appearance of a metallic or reflective surface. The outline of the tankard and its handle is well-defined with a white highlight accentuating the right edge. On the bottom right of the drawing, there is a smaller, less detailed line sketch of the same tankard, including approximate dimensions and proportions. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the main objects are placed inside a faint rectangular border. At the bottom, the name “FRANCIS BORELLI” is written in capital letters.
title: Pewter Mug
